2. **Malware Registration:** Domain modandcrackedapk.com used for staging/obfuscation
3. **Secondary Infrastructure:** geo.netsupportsoftware.com for geolocation queries (infrastructure discovery)
4. **Lateral Movement Attempts:** SMB exploitation attempts against DC (SAMR, share enumeration, AutoRun.inf checks)
